actions.name: Launch the app and select your preferred language.
Tap "Playlist name" and enter any name you like for your playlist.

Enter the full URL of your playlist, which you saved in the step "Copy the playlist URL for your device's player". If you are setting up a TV box, you can paste the URL from the clipboard after copying it from the text file. If you are setting up a non-Android Smart TV, you will need to enter the URL manually. Fortunately, you only need to do this once.
Set the archive duration to 168 hours (the screenshot shows the outdated value of 72), then tap "Load playlist".
Your selected channel groups should now load!
NOTE: The channel lineup in the screenshots may differ from yours. It depends on the provider (playlist) you selected.
